meta.parity_fit: Exact-parity refit (2026-09-20, the maintainer's calibration notes (not published); maintainer: 'I want our output to the bass shaker to be the exact same as the hapticonnect output, including loudness and intensity'). Built by the same notes --spec from the SHIPPED profiles/beamng/profile.json. References: sessions/beamng_drive_1_hc (OutGauge only, engine-dominated, trustworthy level - the lap the profile was fitted on) and sessions/beamng_drive_3_hc restricted to its valid windows 81.09-96.04, 99.04-99.39, 99.69-100.79 s (held out, never scored unmasked). Every intensity below is HaptiConnect's recording against our FULL live mix (the ten preset effects summed + HapticEngine's 0.9-knee soft limiter, master 1.0) at the same moments, in the same band, with the same window - never HaptiConnect's recording against one effect rendered alone. All numbers are on the 2026-09-20 scorer (render cache v5) and came out identical on seeds 1 and 2. Tools and outputs: the same notes (the same notes). (1) The deliberate x0.2488 level anchor of 2026-09-11 is removed (meta.level_fit). (2) engine: HaptiConnect's line is flat at 0.9078 (drive 1, 732 steady windows) / 0.9145 (drive 3, 63) at every rpm below the rev limiter while the profile curve's amplitude column ripples (0.8082 at 880 rpm, 0.91-0.97 above 1200, 0.9448 median), so the column is set to 1.0 and engine.gain 0.908 carries the level: ours/HC +0.02 dB (drive 1) and -0.07 dB (drive 3), against -11.50 / -12.00 dB shipped. That is x3.76 of the shipped engine line (0.2416 -> 0.9099). (3) Rev limiter: NO engine amplitude drop, and the curve's 0.5477/0.5279 rows at 7920/8080 rpm (0.5488/0.5290 in analysis.engine.table) are flattened with the rest. At rpm >= ~0.975 x max_rpm HaptiConnect plays a second voice we do not have - 50-72 Hz power 0.332 (drive 1, 74 windows) / 0.209 (drive 3, 29), a ~60 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated at exactly 10 Hz - and its own limiter ducks its engine under it (HC's line 0.568 / 0.602 there while ours stays at 0.908, i.e. ours +4.0 / +3.5 dB). We play 0.0003 / 0.0008 in that band (-62.2 / -48.7 dB). CODE ITEM, not faked with a gain: the law is rpm/max_rpm, which engine.curve cannot express, and the ducking needs a mixer. (4) gear_shift: pitched at rpm/120 for 0.165 s; pitch_hz_range [10, 120] because at idle (~1375 rpm) HaptiConnect's burst sounds at 11.75 Hz and the default range clamped ours to 20 Hz (ours 11.5 Hz now); gain 0.63 = 0.9 x 0.63 x 0.845 = 0.479 absolute. Burst amplitude in the live mix ours/HC -0.26 dB (drive 1, 15 clean shifts, HC 0.531), +0.20 dB (drive 1, 17 idle shifts, HC 0.480), +0.83 dB (drive 3, 4 shifts, HC 0.510); shipped -10.7 / -10.0 / -9.3 dB. (5) acceleration: unchanged at the shipped 0.2488 and deliberately NOT un-anchored. Holding it while the engine rises x3.76 IS the -11.5 dB correction the measurements ask for. On drive 3, in the 26 windows where our acceleration plays with rpm < 0.975 x max_rpm, no gear change within 0.45 s and the engine line clear of 60 Hz, the 56-64 Hz tone measured against the engine line is ours/HC +2.1 dB (median; +2.9 dB over the 13 windows with rpm < 0.95 x max_rpm), and by the 60 Hz-peak measure over all 39 acceleration steps +0.3 dB (the clean lateral plateau 94.85-95.15 s: -0.8 dB). Un-anchoring it to 1.0 would put that ratio at +13.9 / +15.0 dB and the tone itself +14.2 / +15.4 dB over HaptiConnect. The the same notes candidate's acceleration.gain 0.2559 is dropped: it is 0.24 dB from the shipped value. (6) wheel_slip gain 0 and suspension.idle_tone_amp 0. HaptiConnect's BeamNG preset has no slip effect, and its 41 Hz bed cannot be written as a constant amplitude: measured at 41.3 Hz it is 0.298 with the engine off and the car parked (drive 3, 137-149 s), 0.0100 while the engine alone plays (drive 1, 17 windows where the line stands more than 4x above its own noise shelf) and <= 0.0017, i.e. at that shelf and not detectable, while driving hard on drive 3 (15 windows). A fixed tone sized to drive 1 (idle_tone_amp 0.0145 = 0.0102 absolute) lands on HaptiConnect there (+0.2 dB) but is +15.4 dB over the held-out drive 3, and it moves Dist by only -0.009 (drive 1) / +0.008 (drive 3), so nothing is added. CODE ITEM: HaptiConnect's mixer ducks that bed by 30-45 dB under the engine. Ours now sits -34.2 dB (drive 1) / -9.8 dB (drive 3) under HaptiConnect's 41 Hz line, carried by the engine's own skirt. (7) abs, road and shift_indicator gain 0: HaptiConnect's BeamNG preset runs only RPMs, Gear Shift, Acceleration, Collisions, Suspension and Wheels Lock - no ABS, kerb, slip or shift light. The maintainer's OpenShaker presets force every effect enabled, so this is gain 0, never 'enabled': false. (8) wheel_lock 1.0, impact 1.668 and suspension 0.7 are exactly x4.019 of the shipped gains, i.e. their fitted values before the 2026-09-11 anchor. There is NO usable HaptiConnect evidence for lock, impacts or bumps: drive 3's lock-up and crash fall inside HaptiConnect's replay-fault spans and drive 1 carries no g-forces. Said plainly: restored, not measured. (9) Scores, shipped -> this profile (cache v5, seeds 1 and 2 identical): beamng_drive_1_hc on Session.active (1312 frames) level -10.860 -> +0.417 dB, Dist 14.305 -> 1.569; beamng_drive_3_hc on its valid mask (328 frames) level -9.484 -> +1.162 dB, Dist 12.747 -> 2.734. (10) LOUDNESS WARNING, over ALL driving samples and not only the valid mask: this profile passes HapticEngine's 0.9 knee on 14.98 % of drive 1's 65.6 driving seconds and 19.66 % of drive 3's 32.0, and reaches 0.999 (flat-topped) on 0.92 % / 5.09 %; HaptiConnect on the same drive-1 samples is 10.57 % / 0.00 %. 93 % of drive 3's flat-topped samples lie outside HaptiConnect's valid windows, in the crash and lock-up stretches, where the loudest voice is wheel_lock (53 %) - one of the restored, unmeasured gains of (8). With HaptiConnect's own mixer emulated in place of our soft limiter the same renders pass 0.9 on 13.92 % / 10.53 % of those samples and never flat-top.
meta.parity_open: NOT measured, carried at 1/0.2488 of their fitted values because HaptiConnect's own output faulted at every such moment in both references: wheel_lock 1.0, impact 1.668, suspension 0.7. HaptiConnect's BeamNG preset does have Wheels Lock, Collisions and Suspension at strength 1, so silencing or leaving them 12 dB low would be a known-wrong level; these are the last BeamNG gains without direct evidence. wheel_lock leads about half the samples where our output reaches the limiter, so one new BeamNG recording with a clean lock-up and a clean collision should settle all three.
meta.parity_judgement: Applied 2026-09-20 on the maintainer's exact-parity decision: the x0.2488 same-loudness anchor is gone and BeamNG now plays at HaptiConnect's own level (engine line 0.908 against its 0.91). THESE LEVELS STAND UNTIL ONE CLEAN BeamNG RECORDING EXISTS: wheel_lock 1.0, impact 1.668 and suspension 0.7 are carried at 1/0.2488 of their fitted values with no HaptiConnect evidence at all, because HaptiConnect's output faulted (digital silence, then full-scale blasts) at every lock-up, collision and bump in both references. HaptiConnect's BeamNG preset does play Wheels Lock, Collisions and Suspension at strength 1, so leaving them 12 dB low would be a known-wrong level; the risk is the other way, that one of the three is now too strong. Until the app's mixer matches HaptiConnect's limiter (ceiling 0.985, gain-reducing), about 15% of driving samples cross our 0.9 knee against HaptiConnect's 10.6%, and 0.9-5.1% flat-top where HaptiConnect never does.

meta.limiter_refit: 2026-09-20: gear_shift.gain 0.63 -> 0.9, refitted THROUGH the app's new output limiter (engine.PeakLimiter, ceiling 0.985, the port of HaptiConnect's own limiter). With the limiter, a shift burst ducks the whole mix, as HaptiConnect's does, so the old gain (fitted against a soft clipper that never ducked) left the burst 1.9 dB weak. Measured on the real full-mix output against HaptiConnect, moving shifts: beamng_drive_1_hc (fitted) -1.93 -> -0.14 dB (n 15), beamng_drive_3_hc valid windows (held out) -1.37 -> +0.17 dB (n 4); the engine's duck under a shift +1.62 -> +0.45 and +1.24 -> +0.07 dB; idle shifts -1.08 -> +0.74 dB (n 17). Full-mix level/Dist: drive 1 +0.16 dB / 1.25 -> +0.09 / 1.15, drive 3 +0.72 / 1.99 -> +0.58 / 1.83. The engine gain needed no refit: its steady line reads +0.02 / -0.07 dB through the limiter. The per-effect scorer (optimize.Session) sums effects linearly and cannot show the ducking, so it reads drive 1 worse (1.55 -> 1.67); BeamNG must be judged on the full mix. Scripts: the maintainer's calibration notes (not published).

probes.sampling: HaptiConnect evaluates telemetry ~12x/s (per audio buffer); pulses shorter than ~170 ms are hit or miss
probes.collision: fixed 28 ms hit ~36 Hz; long-axis |g| jump >= ~15 m/s2 held >= 4 frames; vertical ignored; sign ignored; one hit per excursion
probes.wheel_lock: on/off 56.3 Hz full-scale tone when wheel speed <= ~45% of car speed under braking
probes.acceleration: ~60 Hz tone; the 2026-09-10 probe rig put it off below ~9.5 (accel), ~4.5 (braking), ~8.5 (lateral) m/s2 and at full scale within ~2 m/s2 beyond, but in the drive references it plays ~11.5 dB BELOW HaptiConnect's engine line, not at full scale beside it
probes.suspension: 41.3 Hz bed tone, no constant amplitude: 0.298 with the engine off and the car parked, 0.0100 while the engine alone plays, and at or below its own noise shelf (<= 0.0017) while driving hard - HaptiConnect's mixer ducks it 30-45 dB under the engine (the 2026-09-10 '0.31 while moving' was measured with no engine voice running). Bumps on gforce_vertical (not vertical_2) >= ~12 m/s2 add a fixed pulse; no reference shows one outside HaptiConnect's replay-fault spans
probes.gear_shift: one burst per gear change, pitched at rpm/120 Hz, 157-175 ms; at idle (~1375 rpm) HaptiConnect's burst sounds at 11.75 Hz. The '~33 Hz' of the 2026-09-10 probe was that probe running at a constant 4000 rpm (4000/120 = 33.3), not a fixed frequency
probes.engine: tone at rpm/60 Hz, amplitude 0.908 (drive 1) / 0.915 (drive 3) at every rpm below the rev limiter, 2nd harmonic 0.10, throttle independent. NO amplitude cut at the limiter: the 2026-09-10 'cut back at limiter' and the 0.53-0.55 rows at 7920/8080 rpm in analysis.engine.table and in the shipped engine.curve are that probe's rpm/max_rpm artefact. At rpm >= ~0.975 x max_rpm HaptiConnect adds a ~60 Hz voice pulsed at exactly 10 Hz and its own limiter ducks the engine under it (line 0.57-0.60 there)
